protocol: rolling origin, 4 folds, horizon 28d, step 28d, season 7d, quantiles [0.1, 0.5, 0.9], nominal interval 80% = [q0.1, q0.9], min series length 842
cost_model: price EUR 4.50, margin 28%, unit cost EUR 3.24; stockout cost EUR 1.26/unit; overstock cost EUR 1.03/unit (carrying EUR 0.062 over 28d + write-off EUR 0.97 at 30%); critical ratio 0.549
cost_model_source_note: Assumed, not measured. M5 ships unit sales with no cost or price data. Price and margin are grocery-retail rules of thumb, the holding rate is the standard 25 percent annual figure, and the write-off fraction is a judgement. The write-off fraction is the assumption the conclusion is most sensitive to: see sensitivity().
